preconditions.description: The number of nodes n in the tree is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of extra edges m is between 0 and 4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each extra edge connects two distinct nodes, each numbered between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of simple paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
